title: Court emails expose Pentagon-Anthropic clash over autonomous-weapons guardrails
summary: Emails disclosed in Anthropic's lawsuit show Under Secretary Emil Michael calling its limits on autonomous weapons and mass surveillance 'just not workable'; Amodei reiterated these as red lines.
reason: Shows military pressure to remove AI weapon safeguards; date approximate (reported week of Jun 30).

title: Challenger: AI the top cited layoff reason for fourth straight month
summary: US employers announced 45,849 job cuts in June, 14,029 (31%) attributed to AI; AI-linked cuts reached 101,743 year to date, 23% of all announced cuts.
